title: Common definitions — citations, facet sets, versioning

citation.description: One grounding reference. kb form cites a store entry by id+version; prose form cites a document by stable anchor (never line numbers, per F9).

id.description: Namespaced entry id, e.g. palette/flipcard, gates/A3, qaa/criminology-2022

version.description: Entry or store version at citation time.

doc.description: Repo-relative path of the prose source.

ref.description: Stable anchor: decision id (FC-2), section heading, or date+title. Never a line number.

level.description: Institutional academic level (CQFW/FHEQ vocabulary). Property of contexts and source material, NEVER an alias for tier (tier-spec decision #6).

facetSet.description: Context as tags, not a cascade (S1-D3 as twice amended). Facet groups: CORE (pathway, tier — mandatory); CONTEXTUAL (subject(s), level — non-institutional; a course may carry levels with no institutional attachment); INSTITUTIONAL (institution, faculty, school, module); FLOATING (activity — institutional when module-tied, contextual when subject-only). Institutional facets do not BRING level; they may CONSTRAIN it (module pins a singleton; faculty/school may narrow to a range). Nothing beyond the core = baseline.

subject.description: One or more CAH-aligned classifications ('subject matter(s)'). Internally hierarchical within an otherwise flat facet model — flat across facets, laddered within this axis (recorded property, S1-D9). Institutional presence never displaces subject tags: a module carries these AS WELL AS its institutional facets.

level.description: Independent contextual facet, multi-valued: an introductory-tier course may hold {L3,L4,L7} — all honest beginner entry points under experience-anchored tiers. Exists above and independently of institutional facets.

institution.description: Confirmed as string identifier (S4-D5, 27 Aug 2026; provisional lifted at the S4b proving ground). which institution the institutional facets belong to; institutional-kb is multi-institution. Convention: defaults to cardiff-met when any institutional facet is present and this is omitted.

module.description: Institutional module identifier. At most one.

activity.description: Activity-floor tagging: a single activity may carry its own facet set distinct from its course's.

then.description: A module is pitched at exactly one level; module-borne level is a singleton.

provenance.description: Eight-value enum (GI-2 amendment, 27 Aug 2026). human-confirmed at phase close is distinguished via confirmedAt. ai-proposal-stood: for gates with defaultType ai-proposal-stands where the AI's proposal stood on silence, distinct from ai-default-stood which is for fixed-value defaultType gates. advisory-stated: for advisory-hardness gates stated at the moment they apply, never opened for confirmation, never entering the assumptions tally.

gateState.description: Five-value model (13 Aug), superseding the 4 Aug four-value vocabulary. Sixth value added 17 Sep 2026 (Abbott's ruling, Prompt 35, following Prompt 34's stop-and-report on the same question): skipped records a gate whose reachabilityFacet condition (design-kb.gates.schema.json) was not met — the gate was never reached, not decided against. Not a variety of closed: no decidedValue, no provenance, no new required field — the reason is already data on the gate's own store definition, cited via the record's existing grounding array. Not reachable by human choice. Does not block phase close (gate-conversation-model-draft-v1.md §4 names only proposed and undemoted-deferred as blockers).

cahLevel.description: One level of the CAH hierarchy: a code and its display label, as two distinct fields (S1-D9 shape settled, DL-1 AMENDMENT + open-decisions.md, Prompt 67, 18 Sep 2026). code does the matching (e.g. against tools/subject/core/vocab/cah.json, formerly vocab-kb/cah.json; moved under TLS-1, HMD-1, adp-0204); label is for rendering only and never matched against.

label.description: Display label for the code, e.g. 'sociology, social policy and anthropology'.

subjectClassification.description: CAH-aligned subject hierarchy (S1-D9, shape settled per DL-1 AMENDMENT resolution, Prompt 67, 18 Sep 2026): group=CAH1 broad group, discipline=CAH2, subject=CAH3, each a cahLevel (code+label). Any prefix valid — a discipline-level course sets group+discipline only; subject alone is valid (parents derivable from CAH). Codes do the matching; labels are for display only. Matching walks UP the hierarchy, most specific first.

sourceLocator.description: Pointer to a source, never its text (F9). At least one of url/repoPath.

sourceAnchors.description: Citation targets within a source. Stable anchors (section headings/numbers), never line or bare page numbers (F9).

sourceBasis.description: S1-D12's documented/inferred logic applied to sourcing (S4-D6): unverified = entry authored before the document was inspected (structural claims are memory- or report-sourced; VERIFY-ON-RETURN); flips to document-in-hand at population with the document open.

sourceFacets.description: Entry-side retrieval metadata (S1-D2/D3/D9; S4-D4). subject matches by CAH walk-up, most specific first; level by non-empty intersection. pathway/tier are course facets, not source facets - deliberately absent.
